name: Bid For Soccer Cards!
desc:
⚽ Welcome to Bid For Soccer Cards!

Join exciting auction duels, bid your cash, and collect the rarest Soccer Cards!

✅ How to Play:
🏦 Join an auction table
💰 Bid against another player
🃏 Win Soccer Cards and grow your collection
📈 Earn money from your cards
🍀 Upgrade your luck to obtain rarer cards
✨ Discover Gold, Diamond, Rainbow and Secret Cards
🔄 Rebirth to become even stronger
🎁 Gift passes to your friends  

Can you outbid everyone and build the greatest Soccer Card collection?

Leave a like and join our group to support the game and claim a free reward! ❤️
